script: BROKEN — semantic_cluster_collection_update_001.py:162-167 sent POST /collections/s5cu1_1788373537_no_such_collection/cluster with flat body {"operation": "move_shard", "shard_id": 0, "from_peer_id": 424242, "to_peer_id": 424242}; this shape matches no ClusterOperations variant (wire format requires {"move_shard": {"shard_id": ..., "from_peer_id": ..., "to_peer_id": ...}} per lib/collection/src/operations/cluster_ops.rs), so the oracle face 'missing collection -> exactly 404' was never instantiated — all 7 sibling scripts on this endpoint failed body conformance the same or similar ways, and the well-formed probes (state_cluster_collection_update_001/002/003) hit the standalone-deployment 'Distributed mode disabled' 400 before the 404 branch

log: VERDICT: DEFECT_FOUND (Type4_StateLogicViolation) at output_semantic_cluster_collection_update_001.log:4-5 interprets the 400 as 'wrong rejection class / doc drift' for the missing-collection face, but the raw response text in the same log ('Format error in JSON body: data did not match any variant of untagged enum ClusterOperations', time=0.0) shows a framework-level body-format rejection that never evaluated collection existence — the verdict's misdisposition interpretation is a downstream consequence of the script-link break
chain_trace.break_detail: Root break at the script link: the request body is not a schema-conformant ClusterOperations payload, so the claimed scenario (documented 404 disposition for a missing collection) was never exercised; the observed 400 is the documented-class format rejection produced by the actix payload extractor before the handler runs. Secondary (downstream) misreading at the log link: the Type4 verdict treats this format rejection as a wrong-disposition of the 404 face. A corrected probe is additionally masked on this deployment: with cluster.enabled=false (standalone container testvdb-qdrant-standalone), do_update_collection_cluster returns 400 'Distributed mode disabled' before get_collection, so the 404 branch is unreachable here (state_cluster_collection_update_001 lines A/B/C).

a flat {"operation": ...} object matches none). cluster_ops.rs:138-142 — pub struct MoveShardOperation { #[validate(nested)] pub move_shard: MoveShard, } (wire form is a one-key wrapper object). cluster_ops.rs:259-267 — pub struct MoveShard { pub shard_id: ShardId, ... pub to_peer_id: PeerId, pub from_peer_id: PeerId, pub method: Option<ShardTransferMethod>, }. src/actix/api/collections_api.rs:215-234 — #[post("/collections/{collection_name}/cluster")] async fn update_collection_cluster(dispatcher: web::Data<Dispatcher>, collection: Path<CollectionPath>, operation: Json<ClusterOperations>, Query(query): Query<WaitTimeout>, ActixAuth(auth): ActixAuth) -> impl Responder { ... let response = do_update_collection_cluster(&dispatcher.into_inner(), collection.collection_name.clone(), operation.0, auth, wait_timeout).await; process_response(response, timing, None) } (the Json<ClusterOperations> extractor deserializes the body BEFORE the handler body runs; on failure actix rejects with 400 and the handler is never invoked). src/actix/mod.rs:249-253,258-267 — actix_web_validator::Error::JsonPayloadError(actix_web::error::JsonPayloadError::Deserialize(err)) => { format!("Format error in {name}: {err}",) } ... let response = match &err { actix_web_validator::Error::Validate(_) => HttpResponse::UnprocessableEntity(), _ => HttpResponse::BadRequest() }.json(ApiResponse::<()> { result: None, status: ApiStatus::Error(msg), time: 0.0, usage: None }); (exact generator of the observed body: 400 + status.error='Format error in JSON body: data did not match any variant of untagged enum ClusterOperations' + time 0.0). src/common/collections.rs:260-264 — if dispatcher.consensus_state().is_none() { return Err(StorageError::bad_request("Distributed mode disabled".to_string())); } ; collections.rs:296-299 — let collection = dispatcher.toc(&auth, &pass).get_collection(&collection_pass).await?; (404-on-missing-collection branch, reached only AFTER auth and the consensus check); collections.rs:278-291 — validate_peer_exists returns Err(StorageError::bad_request(format!("Peer {peer_id} does not exist"))) (documented 400-invalid-peer validation present); collections.rs:304-309 — if !collection.contains_shard(move_shard.shard_id).await { return Err(StorageError::bad_request(format!("Shard {} of {} does not exist", ...))) } (documented 400-invalid-shard validation present). lib/storage/src/dispatcher.rs:27,32-38,55-57 — consensus_state: Option<ConsensusStateRef>, None in Dispatcher::new, set only via with_consensus. src/main.rs:479,559-571 — let is_distributed_deployment = settings.cluster.enabled; ... if is_distributed_deployment { ... dispatcher = dispatcher.with_consensus(consensus_state.clone(), settings.cluster.resharding_enabled); } (standalone default config: cluster.enabled=false -> consensus_state() None -> 'Distributed mode disabled' 400 precedes the 404 branch).

mundane_explanation.surviving: request_parameter_construction: the script's flat body {"operation": "move_shard", "shard_id": 0, "from_peer_id": 424242, "to_peer_id": 424242} is not a schema-conformant ClusterOperations payload (untagged enum requires the one-key wrapper {"move_shard": {...}}), so the 400 is a body-format rejection that preempts the collection lookup — the claimed missing-collection disposition was never tested; deployment_mode: the standalone container (testvdb-qdrant-standalone, cluster.enabled=false) returns 400 'Distributed mode disabled' before the 404 branch even for well-formed bodies (state_cluster_collection_update_001 lines A/B/C), so the documented 404 face of this distributed-section endpoint is unobservable on this deployment. Under these two surviving mundane explanations no target-misbehavior signal survives from the primary observation.
